verdict.rationale: MailerSend is a transactional email, SMS and WhatsApp delivery service, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the opposite role: an MCP server that AI assistants connect to (mcp.mailersend.com). That server-side evidence does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
